items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The Pat Metheny Quintet with Dewey Redman, Michael Brecker, Metheny, Charlie Haden and yourself... Well, Pat and I had been playing together.

ctx.x: We’ll look it up. Since we’re in the 80’s, I want to talk about a project that bears that as the title 80/81. The Pat Metheny Quintet with Dewey Redman, Michael Brecker, Metheny, Charlie Haden and yourself. Was this the first project that you did with Pat and how did this come about?
Well, Pat and I had been playing together. The recorded project is the first time we’d recorded.
